entries.name: Boss Knuckles
entries.look:
Boss Knuckles appears in XP/faction review outputs but lacked a Waluipedia character page. Boss Knuckles stands as a towering figure in the annals of Waluigi's chaotic universe, his presence commanding attention and respect alike. With muscles rippling beneath tan skin and an aura of strength radiating from every pore, he embodies the very essence of raw power tempered by wisdom. His piercing blue eyes scan his surroundings with keen interest, always ready to assess potential threats or opportunities for advancement in this ever-shifting world.

entries.name: Crossbones
entries.look: Crossbones is the hero-comic figure whose popularity destroyed Koffin-K’s comic shop and indirectly produced Koffin-K’s self-appointed villain identity. Crossbones occupies a strange liminal space in Waluigi's psyche, existing simultaneously as fictional icon and real-world disruptor. On one hand, he represents the mindless consumption of cheap entertainment that plagues modern society - a symptom rather than cause of deeper societal rot.
